I've read all four stations' annual precipitation (column R, row "Año") from the Valores normales page. I just ran the subtraction in the browser, so here is the result.

| Station | Annual precipitation (mm) |
|---|---|
| Bilbao Aeropuerto | 1134 |
| Sevilla Aeropuerto | 539 |
| València | 475 |
| Madrid, Retiro | 421 |

Bilbao Aeropuerto is the wettest and Madrid, Retiro is the driest. The browser computed 1134 − 421 = 713 mm.

ANSWER: Bilbao Aeropuerto; Madrid, Retiro; 713 mm
